//: Story Phase 16: the Fart Zone's rules, the captain's beard (contamination profile), the captain's journal, the TV listings. Every logbook and entry here waits on a Phase 16 flag.

fart_zone_rules.title: The Stenchmaster Fart Zone: Rules
fart_zone_rules.byline: <k>Posted</> on the board by the door of the old sail locker. <k>Underlined</> by Pete (number nine, three times).

entries.title: Rule 1
entries.rule: If a Grand Stenchmaster feels a major release coming: enter the room.

entries.title: Rule 11
entries.rule: Two Stenchmasters at once: the overflow procedure (the second waits on deck, upwind).

captains_beard.title: The Captain's Beard
captains_beard.byline: <k>A contamination profile,</> compiled with a lantern, a mirror and the Grand Sashback terminal, which gave it 999.

entries.title: Garrick (original)
entries.note: The first one. The treasure room. Where it all started (Story Phase 2).

entries.title: Brogath (ancient)
entries.note: Ancient Grand Stenchmaster, through cardboard (Story Phase 14).

entries.title: Grand Bank deposits
entries.note: Every deposit you ever held a sash for, layered (Story Phases 14-15).

entries.title: Skunk haze
entries.note: The green one, which the beard rejected: why you're the only one who never gets mellow (Story Phase 15).

entries.title: Coffin Sock
entries.note: Ancient. Dusty. Stale. Musty. Beans. It outranks everything else in there (chapter 188).

entries.title: Vindicta (legendary)
entries.note: A legendary ceremonial release, at point-blank range, while carrying a chicken (chapter 190).

entries.title: Grand Lighter fuel
entries.note: Thirty-two attempts, one of them right under your chin (chapter 187).

entries.title: Currency Converter
entries.note: One Grand Token's worth of Coffin Sock, straight from the output horn (chapter 195).

entries.title: Hornets
entries.note: They live in it now. STINGBEARD. (It passes.)

entries.title: The Grand Lighter
entries.notes: THE GRAND STENCHMASTER'S GRAND LIGHTER OF GRAND SMOKES. Cheap-O-Rama, out of the Sharkstorm, for shouting. Clicks so far: {num:lighter_clicks}. Flames: some.

entries.title: The Stenchmaster Fart Zone
entries.where: The old sail locker, under the cargo grating
entries.holder: Grand Stenchmasters, one at a time
entries.notes: Door shut. Portholes open. Out to sea. The door has a bulge in it the shape of Vindicta. It held.

entries.title: Agnes the Second
entries.notes: Came back round the Sharkstorm on her pillow and walked straight into the Fart Zone as Vindicta went in. Watch the gap, grab, run. A bit bald in places. On page sixty-one of an application now: DO NOT TOAST.

entries.title: The Grand Bank (again)
entries.where: The counter in the old quarters
entries.notes: A dispensary took in tokens and the tokens turned into a gentleman. I am, apparently, still a teller. And an underwriter. With my NOSE.

entries.title: The Hornets
entries.where: My beard. Then the bank. Then away over the Sharkstorm at sunset.
entries.notes: Brogath's HORNET FART, by the procedure, out of the portholes, mostly. STINGBEARD, they called me. Temporary. Every one of them has a card with a strand of my beard on it.

entries.title: The Bureau of Ceremonial Ignition
entries.notes: Ninety-seven pages. A Council. Vindicta, very nearly. And then a lighter that works sometimes, and a queue of people asking for it. COMMON SENSE IS WINNING. (Sometimes.)

entries.title: Cheap-O-Rama: The Grand Lighter (advert)
entries.summary: Cheapy the Cheapskate Clown. NOW WITH GRANDNESS! WORKS SOMETIMES! (*SOMETIMES.)
entries.reaction: Came on the Mark II by itself. Brogath had his eyes shut.

entries.title: Before the Grand Lighter
entries.summary: The ceremonial Fire-Waft; the Bureau of Ceremonial Ignition (97 pages per cigar); Cheapy's 'invention'. On the portable set, in the bunker. Repeats.
entries.reaction: 'I did it once. I was too shy to aim.'
